reason: After the wandering scare I'm not waiting around for a perfect product. Live video and GPS on him would let me find him fast, and $249 is less than one night of a home-care aide.
objection: My father will take one look at a camera clipped to him and refuse to wear it. Then I've paid $249 and the monthly fee for a box in a drawer, and I still have to watch him wander.
would_change_my_mind: Proof it can be worn in something he already wears, like a jacket pocket or shoe insert, so he never sees a medical device.
